decisions.reason: The click-in adapter was featured publicly on the home page and is part of the firm's track system, so it carries a visible commitment and is central to its flexible modular lighting direction.

A single LED luminaire launched in 2018 is the kind of item a premium luminaire maker rotates out over time, but it is close to the core offer and there is no evidence of failure, so the firm keeps it for now.
The home automation server box reflects substantial engineering investment and the firm's announced move into home automation, so management stays committed to it even if adoption has been slow.
The luminaire family got its own dedicated page, signalling sizeable investment and public commitment, and it fits the established premium design range, so management persists with it.
